host_reference_scope: Read-only Debian 13 host observation; not a target-image lock or release approval.
limitations: Versions are intentionally captured from the separately built immutable target image, not copied from the host.

The host evidence covers ELF/package/copyright provenance for 39 requested libraries; jq was observed separately as 1.7.1-6+deb13u4 with copyright SHA-256 0640a24687148cb525f6e917f982846c7d6682ccb13b939383d7bb596e7b29f5.
Engine binaries, transitive plugins, runtime behavior and operational acceptance remain separate.

The image resource layout routes Debian Prusa fixed FHS paths to the selected read-only generation. Font files come from fonts-noto-core and fonts-noto-cjk inside the target image, not from copied host font files. Image/runtime verification is still pending.
